notes.title: Dev Update: Answering Your Questions, First Batch
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders.


Today we’re sharing the first batch of answers to your questions. 

More will arrive next week, so if you haven’t asked anything yet, you can still post your question in the comments under this announcement!
    
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
Question
[/td][td]
Answer
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
How confident are devs about early access within this year?
[/td][td]
We’ll be able to determine that throughout our next beta cycle. Experiences of the past two years taught us not to commit to a release window unless we’re 100% confident in meeting them. Right now we can’t say more than that our goal is to deliver an experience that’s fun, stable, and runs well when it finally lands in your hands.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Will the silksong Release in any way Change the starminer Release?
[/td][td]
No, the Silksong release did not in any way or form affect the release or development of Starminer.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
will there be any lore previews and/or a dedicated discord server section with info and discussion on the lore? (They're doing something similar for Falling Frontier lately, so I thought something similar could be nice for Starminer also)
[/td][td]
That is an interesting and lucrative idea - we will put more thought into it. The lore of Starminer is definitely something we will continuously expand and build upon with the help of our narrative designer Aidan.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
will there be a feature for saving ships' and stations' blueprints and export them to share them, maybe through Steam Workshop?)
[/td][td]
Yes! We’re working on a feature that will let players share their station blueprints with others. Right now you can already save and recall your own blueprints through the build menu - the next step is adding the backend that makes it possible to share them with the community. This feature will be available in-game.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Are there any plans to add planetary mining? Like maybe rare exotic resources that can only be obtained by first making a ship that can enter an atmosphere?
[/td][td]
We don’t have plans to include planetary mining at release, but it’s definitely something that fits naturally into Starminer. It’s an idea we’ve already talked about internally, and in one form or another, it’s very likely to make its way into the game in the future.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Will there be community references in the game, like decals?
[/td][td]
Good idea, we will definitely include some community easter eggs at some point.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Any chance we can have like a “early backer pay extra” option that gets our names in game like for NPCs or Star names?
I’d totally pay up to $10-15 more if it meant an NPC/location/whatever with my game tag
[/td][td]
That's up to our publisher.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
gamemodes question: probably a story mode, but what about "endless" or similar?
or is it more like rimworld in that its always story mode and always endless?
[/td][td]
Starminer will launch with three game modes: Campaign, Sandbox, and Survival.
In Campaign, players progress through a series of missions designed to introduce both the core mechanics and the game’s lore. While there’s structure, the missions aren’t strictly linear and you’ll still have plenty of freedom in how you approach them.
Sandbox offers a more customizable experience, letting you choose your starting ship, resources, location, and whether enemies are active or not.
Survival is all about endurance: you’ll face endless waves of enemies and fight to stay alive as long as possible. All three game modes will continue to be refined and expanded during Early Access, guided by feedback from the community.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Is it out yet? (Sorry. I had to do it.... i will show myself out) Jokes aside though, im curious on scales. Scale of the universe, 
scale of ships, scale of factions etc. What kind of scale is the devs aiming to be "scope" if you will.
[/td][td]
Nah, it's not out, sorry to disappoint :). As for scale: Starminer spans three star systems - Sol, Lalande, and Alpha Centauri - with more than 25 distinct environments. The campaign features dozens of missions of varying length and difficulty (and we are still adding more). Ships can be built as large as you like, with the only real limit being your CPU. Our aim is to keep the scope manageable for our small team, while still making the universe feel vast and alive.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
build limits?
[/td][td]
As mentioned earlier, there are no build limits. You can grow as big as you like - the only limit is what your computer can handle.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Space Sim has been a tremendous market. What’s the identity/ core focus of this project compared to iconic like 
Elite Dangerous, Eve, X4, etc?
[/td][td]
The core focus of Starminer is creativity, customisation and physics. We want players to have the freedom to approach challenges in their own way, whether that means customizing a station, designing a ship, or experimenting with different strategies. Unlike large space sims like X4 or Elite Dangerous, Starminer places a strong emphasis on creative building and heavy customization. Another key distinction is our physics simulation: things like mass, thrust, and structural integrity really matter, adding a layer of depth and realism that sets the game apart from these heavyweight titles.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Will there be a 12 hour space ship docking scene?
[/td][td]
Our team is still pondering on whether or not to include that feature.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Will ship controls by more direct (space engineers, elite dangerous) or more abstract (nebulous fleet command)
[/td][td]
Direct ship controls are one of Starminer's key features, giving you full inputs across all six degrees of freedom. At the same time, we are developing a point-and-click navigation aid to help with long-distance travel or tricky maneuvers, but it is meant as a support tool rather than the main way to play the game.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
will there be power managment systems
[/td][td]
You can manage your ship's power by toggling various systems on or off. Mining lasers, weapons, shields, refineries, and factories each have dedicated controls to switch them all at once, and you can also toggle individual modules if you want more fine-grained control over energy use.
[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Dev Update: AMA & Tutorial Showcase
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!


We’re heads-down fixing bugs, polishing the experience, and preparing to scale up the Closed Beta. We know you want to learn more - and get hands-on - so here are two things we can do right now:


First: an AMA. Our Discord moderator, Tarlin, kicked it off by gathering questions, and we’re expanding it to other platforms. How it works:
[olist]
Post your questions about the devs and/or the game under this post.

We’ll gather them, then answer as time allows.

Answers will be posted in batches so you get a steady flow of info. 
[/olist]
Question guidelines:
[olist]
Be civil and respectful (if it violates ToS, it’ll be removed.)

Personal questions to developers are optional to answer at their discretion.

We can’t share dates right now (release, scaled-up Closed Beta, etc.), so please skip those.

[/olist]
Second, with the help of Charlie Pryor, we’re showcasing our upgraded tutorial. And we’ve already made several additional fixes since - to improve the experience! Watch it, and if you have any questions about the tutorial, drop them below - we’ll grab them for the AMA.

[previewyoutube="dvVbdS9SWjA;full"][/previewyoutube]

And that’s it for today.

See you in Space!

notes.title: Starminer Development Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have some updates to share about Starminer.

New Release Window
First, we have a new release window for our game, and as a result we won’t release in Early Access this year. We’re now aiming to launch in 2025, and will announce the final release date a bit later.

We understand that a delay is not the kind of news any of you wanted to hear, so we want to share a few things that will hopefully soften the blow a bit!

Development Progress
Most importantly, the development of the game is going well! We made a lot of good progress this year, and we hope you saw it in some of the trailers we shared in recent months. To give you a better idea of what we worked on these past 12 months, here is a "before" and "after" shot of early game of Starminer:

October 2023 build:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809242/c21e67c19a1ac585a84620200a259663bb01affd.jpg
November 2024 build:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809242/f739363878717b4ce74f4385e133ed53156e336e.jpg

What you can probably see first, is increase in modularity and component variety of space rigs and stations, and an example of what you can easily create in the game now, vs a year ago. Some of these new modules we already covered in Developer Diary 6, and we'll tell you more about the many new nodes we introduced, in the coming days!

You can also see some of the progress we've been making with UI. Starminer is a complex game, and to make it a fun experience, we're working hard to make sure the UI and UX make it easier to learn and master the game.

That aside, there is plenty of work being done on various in-game systems. Here is a list of some of the features and content we added or improved over the past year. Deduce from them however much you want... :)

Development progress October 2023 - November 2024:

 Complete interface and UI rehaul
 Docking and merging stations
 Asteroid hauling - the ability to grab and transport asteroids
 Asteroid bases - build modules and installations on asteroids
 Over 15 new modules
 2 new "commander" type ships with their own upgrades
 Heating system and radiators, with two different types of heat management, radiation and thermal dumping
 Officers - hire different officer types with perks to unlock as they level-up (engineering, combat, construction, logistics, science)
 New sandbox mode with various customizable settings: location, enemy difficulty, starting resources and more
 New campaign mode and rehauled tutorial
 Intro story sequence
 NPC dialogue system
 6 new starting classes each with different perks to unlock and level-up
 Starmap and starmap travel
 10 new space sectors
 2 new resource types: H20 and eonite
 3 types of missions - story missions, bounties, contracts
 Revamped research tree and player progression
 Autonomous combat frigates
 Improved build system for free building in 3d space (construction points)
 Updated graphics&FX, loads of optimizations for much better performance 
 Full Nvidia DLSS integration


Finally, just as a curiosity, here is a shot from the first ever build of Starminer. We've come a long way!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809242/d5f9d5b5cf7b4113ca6b418a262ff0ecf3a54d4e.jpg
What's next?
Together with our publisher, we’re committed to give you the best, hardcore space mining simulation we can, and that’s the main reason why we want to work on Starminer a bit longer.

That said, we know that you want to see more! 

First, we can promise more Developer Diaries and videos before the release. Next Dev Diary will land this month, and will dive more into the subject of nodes! There is plenty left to talk about how you can build your stations and ships!

Before the end of the year, we also want to invite you all to join us for a special end-of-year stream. We’ll play the game, and answer your questions! More details on that will come soon!

For now, we wanted to thank you for your patience! Your support matters a lot and we can’t wait to get Starminer in your hands #whenitsready!
